title: Archytan Lite receipt export, version 2 layout
description: The receipts.json file written by archytan-lite --export-chain since Archytan Lite 2.4. Each entry is a receipt as stored, version 1 or 2: a log written across an upgrade holds both, and each row's receipt_version says which rules verify it. A version 1 row has empty v2 fields (and observe_override false); a version 2 row has a policy_sha256, a caller_id and a mode. Unlike the receipt /v1/authorize returns, each row includes idempotency_key, which the signed intent covers and an offline verifier needs. The export directory also holds manifest.json, its signature manifest.sig, a README and the source of a standalone verifier that checks signatures and the chain; this schema checks the file's shape only. See internal/receipt/store.go (StoredReceipt).

format.description: Format identifier. The earlier layout, without receipt_version or v2 fields, is archytan-lite-receipts-v1 (see receipts-export.v1.json).

receipts.description: Every receipt in the gate's chain, in sequence order, ALLOW and BLOCK alike.

seq.description: Position in the chain, starting at 1.

receipt_version.description: Which rules and signature tag verify this row.

receipt_id.description: "rcpt_" followed by 16 random bytes in hex.

action.description: The action requested, as named in policy.json.

resource_type.description: The type of the resource the action targets.

resource_id.description: The resource the action targets. Signed, so it can't be redacted without breaking verification.

actor_uid.description: The actor identifier the caller supplied.

actor_role.description: The role the decision was made against.

idempotency_key.description: The request's idempotency key, part of the signed intent.

intent_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the row's signed fields, by its version.

signature.description: Hex Ed25519 signature over intent_hash, under the tag for the row's version.

operator_urn.description: The gate instance that made the decision.

chain_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 link to the receipt before it.

created_at.description: The decision time exactly as stored (RFC 3339, UTC, nanoseconds). Signed in a v2 row.

caller_id.description: v2: the authenticated credential. Empty in a v1 row.

resource_tenant_id.description: v2: the tenant named on the resource, empty when none. Empty in a v1 row.

policy_sha256.description: v2: hex SHA-256 of the policy file the decision used. Empty in a v1 row.

callers_sha256.description: v2: hex SHA-256 of the callers file, empty in shared-secret mode. Empty in a v1 row.

mode.description: v2: the gate's mode. Empty in a v1 row.

observe_override.description: v2: true when observe mode turned a BLOCK into this ALLOW. False in a v1 row.

otel_trace_id.description: v2: the caller's W3C trace id, empty when none. Empty in a v1 row.
